dispute.claim_text: I booked at 6.30am for an airport run and got charged $4 for not showing up. I did come down, just a few minutes later than the app wanted. Four dollars for nothing. I want it back.

counterparty_statement.text: I waited eight and a half minutes at Blk 682, well past the five minutes. Nobody came down. This is my job and I lost the fare and the time. Please pay the cancellation.
